dct_description_sm: The purpose of this case study is to assess the vulnerability of Highway 3 between Behchoko and Yellowknife in the Northwest Territories to climate change. Constructed on discontinuous permafrost, damages since 1999 are believed to be caused by degradation of permafrost. A climate change vulnerability assessment was conducted to quantify the role of climate change on permafrost on the highway in line with the Department of Transportation's highway stability assessment. The objectives of the project were: (1) To define the infrastructure components for Highway 3 that encompasses its design, construction, management, operation and maintenance; (2) to determine the likely effects of climate on individual components of the infrastructure; (3) to undertake consultations with Department of Transportation management, planning, engineering, operations, and maintenance staff; (4) to provide recommendations to address the engineering vulnerabilities; and (5) prepare a report and presentation slides.
